faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for UP Government Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 31 October 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UP Government Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 120 vacancies: 100 Operator, Apprentice Trainee, Temporary Worker, 20 Computer Operator or Back-End Executive.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for UP Government Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 31 October 2026 at 10:00 AM. The documents to bring are given in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Operator: 18 to 35 years; Apprentice Trainee: 18 to 25 years; Temporary Worker: 18 to 32 years; Computer Operator or Back-End Executive: 20 to 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹24,257 to ₹26,484 for Operator, ₹13,870 stipend for Apprentice Trainee, ₹15,488 for Temporary Worker, ₹13,000 to ₹18,000 for Computer Operator or Back-End Executive.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 10th, 12th, ITI, Graduate. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Good communication skills required for computer operator and back-end executive roles.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview and recruitment drive. Campus placement drive involving multiple companies including Tata Motors, Dixon Technologies, and Corps Data Information Services.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Apprentice training for 1 year. Temporary worker max work duration of 6 months.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by UP Government Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Noida, Lucknow.
